about_the_game:
Step into the boots of a man who’s done with mercy.
In this fast-paced retro FPS, you’ll cleanse a city infested with fanatical cultists and vile criminals, armed only with raw firepower and an unbreakable sense of justice.

Every bullet you fire is personal — the protagonist despises corruption, violence, and the scum that poison society. He doesn’t fight for glory; he fights to erase evil.

⚔️ Features

  • Brutal, satisfying combat inspired by the golden age of 90s shooters — fast, responsive, and bloody.

  • Classic gunplay with modern precision — tight controls, punchy weapons, and no hand-holding.

  • Dark atmosphere — explore decaying streets, cult hideouts, and blood-soaked halls under a haunting soundtrack.

  • Old-school challenge — no regenerating health, no safe checkpoints. Every room is earned through skill and instinct.

  • Minimalist storytelling — uncover the cult’s grip on the city through cryptic notes, symbols, and the aftermath of violence.

  • Driven by justice — the protagonist’s hatred for criminals fuels every action, every reload, every kill.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild, stylized gore and cartoonish violence that may not be suitable for sensitive players.
